instructor: If you are taking this course with Yasemin Hocam, you have likely already spent a significant amount of time with her, and her knowledge and passion for teaching are well known within the faculty. It is clear that she genuinely enjoys teaching this course, which reflects strongly in her engaging way of explaining the material. She consistently brings in additional resources and materials with the aim of helping students become better designers, and she creates a classroom environment where no one feels pressured or uncomfortable. She knows her students well and never forces participation, instead choosing to encourage it gently. However, because participation is handled so openly, I feel that some students tend to take advantage of this flexibility. When students contribute without having completed the readings or steer the discussion toward unrelated topics, it takes away from the limited class time and from what Yasemin Hocam could otherwise teach. Her kindness and consideration sometimes make it difficult for her to interrupt these moments, even though extended comments without clear relevance do not always add value to the discussion.
